name: orb-geometry-conformance-reports
instr:
orb lacks opt-in geometry conformance reporting with stable, actionable locations for malformed geometry. Add it without changing geometry values or existing serialization. Cover Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Ring, Polygon, MultiPolygon, Bound, and Collection. GeoJSON adaptation and validated MVT marshaling must match direct core validation.

Make validation total, non-mutating, and deterministic. Report every issue in depth-first path order and terminate safely for nil members, malformed slices, non-finite coordinates, and collection cycles. Recursively enforce structural and topological invariants. Compose child failures under original member indexes while preserving values valid for that representation, including empty and nil MultiPoints, duplicate finite MultiPoint members, and nil Collection members. Distinguish LineString cardinality, non-finite-coordinate, and consecutive-duplicate failures. Report recursive Collection self-reference as a cycle issue.

Options control only duplicate vertices, polygon orientation, and cross-polygon overlap. Preserve shell, hole, ring, segment, and component identity, with related paths for intersections and overlap. Finite zero-area bounds and empty or nil multipoints are valid. Reversed bounds retain distinct axis locations.

`github.com/paulmach/orb` must export `IssueKind`, `PathStepKind`, `PathStep`, `GeometryPath`, `ValidationIssue`, `ValidationReport`, `ValidationOptions`, `Validate`, `Geometry.Validate`, and `V
